behavior: continue-on-error on a guarded step, on the hygiene job or on any other step fails the check, whatever its value.
An if on a guarded step or on the job, needs on the job, or a guarded run missing or nested under another key fails the check.
The current repo-hygiene.yml, a comment naming continue-on-error, the AI-trailer step's if and a CRLF copy are accepted; a CRLF copy of a red case stays red.
Adding continue-on-error: true to either guarded step of the real workflow makes the check exit non-zero.
verification: d=$(mktemp -d) && for c in 'scripts/check-conflict-markers.sh' 'scripts/tests/test-conflict-markers.sh'; do awk -v c="        run: bash $c" '{print} $0==c{print "        continue-on-error: true"}' .github/workflows/repo-hygiene.yml > "$d/p.yml" && ! bash scripts/tests/test-hygiene-wiring.sh "$d/p.yml" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; done

behavior: Repository hygiene runs the wiring check as its own step.
